name: The Ridge Protocol: Solo Weekend
summary: A solo weekend on a strict written schedule of long walks and sits, silent until 6pm, with a phone call to a coach each evening. Secular. Physically hard. Some prior practice helpful. £140.
description:
The Ridge Protocol is a fixed two-day schedule for one person, run from a bunkhouse we rent on the edge of the moor.

**The schedule**
Day 1: 6.00 sit (30). 6.45 walk, 12 miles, marked route (return by 13.00). Lunch. 14.00 sit (45). 15.00 walk, 6 miles. 18.00 silence ends; call with your coach (30 min). Supper. 20.30 sit. Day 2 the same with a different route. It is written on one card and you are asked to follow it exactly.

**Silence**
Until the 6pm call each day. The bunkhouse is yours; there is no one else there.

**Coach**
Secular. The two evening calls are the only guidance: a debrief and a few questions. Coaches are MBSR-trained and have done the protocol themselves.

**Demand**
Eighteen miles of moorland a day plus two hours of sitting. Come fit and with boots that fit.

**Level**
People who have some experience of sitting and are used to long walks alone. Not for a first go at either.

**Cost**
£140 including the bunkhouse and two calls; you bring food.
practical: Friday night to Sunday evening, most weekends. £140. One person. Bunkhouse with stove, bunk, kitchen; bring your own food. Bring full hill kit, map, compass, boots. Nearest station Edale. Signal at the door for the evening call only.
